page.layout: Two woodcut medallions at the top, left and right, with ring legends (not running text); below them one column of text with two paragraphs, then an italic verse line followed by a continuation paragraph. Running head centred at top; page number at top right.

main_text.l: THESEVS
MINOTAVRVS[?]
THESEVS Ægei Athenárum Regis filius , ex Æthra
Pithei filia, regnauit Athenis anno mundi 2730. ante Chri-
stum natum 1232. Hic Herculem imitatus,mare ingressus est:
ad ea certamina adiecit animum, quæ laudem & gloriam sibi
essent allatura: iuuenis adhuc Creontem tyrannum occîdit:
præterea taurum vastantem Atticam, & Minotaurum: item
Scyronem,Procruftem,& Schynin latrones, in Attica trucida-
uit. Cum Hercule aduersus Amazonas strenuè militauit, qua-
rum reginam Hippolyten abduxit, ex qua filium Hippolytum
suftulit. Iustin lib.2. Diodor.lib.5.Plutarc. in vita Thesei,Ouid.
epist.4.& 10. Hic firmam amicitiam cum Pirithoo iunxit.
MINOTAVRVS, filius fuit Pasiphaë, & iuuenis cuius-
dam formosissimi,nomine Tauri,qui, morbo laborante Minoë
marito Pasiphaës,cum hac concubuit, peperitque Pasiphaë ip-
sa ex eo concubitu filium,qui inde Minotaurus dictus est,quòd
cùm Minoïs filius putaretur , revera tamen Tauri filius esset:
quem ideo Minos relegauit,atque infectatus est:ad quem tan-
dem Theseû misit, qui accepto ense ab Ariadne , eum occîdit.
Hæc Palephatus libro de non credendis fabulosis narrationi-
bus. De hoc Minotauro multa fabulantur Poëtæ, quòd semi-
uir, ac semibos fuerit, vnde Ouid.
quòd Labyrintho, à Dædalo fabrefacto inclusus , obiectos sibi
homines deuorarit. Vergil.lib.6. Ænei.Ouid.epist.10.

page.notes: The two medallions are woodcut portraits with ring legends. The left one reads THESEVS. The right one shows a bull and a bearded head; its legend is only partly legible (MINOTAVRVS is inferred from the visible letters), so the second legend line is marked [?]. The verse line is set in italics, indented, and the following prose line starts at the left margin, so it is given as a separate paragraph continuing the same sentence. No marginal notes, catchword or signature on the page.
